author: bunkss
title: Paid mascot character designer / 3D artist
content: Looking for a character designer or 3D artist to help bring a mascot concept to life. Ideally someone with experience creating expressive characters for brands. This is a paid project. If that’s you, drop your portfolio below or DM me!

author: sugarspikez
title: Background artist needed Dec–May
content: I’m going to need a background artist from December until May. I already have concepts and sketches, I just need someone who enjoys creating backgrounds to help me out! It would be 5 locations from multiple angles. Please send me your rates if you want to collab with me.
